cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the 2024 personal data proclamation covers personal data in general.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): Proclamation 1321/2024's local-storage rule binds personal data held by any controller, not state data (ETH-001). Digital Ethiopia 2030 sets a sovereign national cloud as a goal (ETH-002), so stage 2.
